claims: Monitor respiratory status closely with continuous pulse oximetry and reassess oxygen needs, given tachypnea (RR 22-27) and SpO2 92-97% on 2-3 L/min nasal cannula.
Obtain blood cultures and reassess for infection given leukocytosis (WBC 19 K/uL) and fever up to 99.7 F.
Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and telemetry given tachycardia (HR up to 120 bpm) and need to assess for arrhythmia or ischemia.
Reassess pain and continue to monitor response to ondansetron for nausea, with pain reported as mild to moderate (up to 5/10).
Perform a fall risk reassessment and implement fall precautions given weak gait/transferring and bed rest status.
Obtain a chest radiograph to evaluate for pulmonary source of infection or other cause of tachypnea and hypoxia.
Monitor blood pressure closely with non-invasive cuff and reassess need for antihypertensive therapy, as systolic BP ranged up to 145 mmHg with alarm limits.
Assess volume status and renal function with daily weights and basic metabolic panel, given creatinine 0.4 mg/dL and BUN 9 mg/dL.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Maintain IV access and continue to monitor for need for fluid resuscitation or medication administration via existing IV.
